about: The user's short price questions (database/data/stock_qa/user_short_templates/price_short_v1.jsonl), 255 templates in 17 categories. The dev ones are router examples with the facts route on; the test ones only measure it (route_encoders --facts).
split: test is stock_qa.held_out(ids, 0.2, category, 'price_short_v1'): a fifth of each category, the same on every run
fills: {t} is the share, as in finance.FACTS_PARAPHRASES; a second share is {t} too. A time period is 'the last month' ('the next month' in USR-212), a benchmark 'the nifty 50' and an event date 'its last results'.
labels: The route whose answer holds what is asked: a price intent when its answer form does, facts when only the facts lines do, unsupported when nothing does (intraday, gaps, 52-week highs and lows, a benchmark's return, a second share, EMA, ADX, Bollinger levels, weekly bars).
